svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 06 · Merced · 08/12 The Road In (Common)
svg.desc: A long straight road out from town past fields and ditches. Then the campus shows up all at once. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
